name: Virtuous CRM
description: Virtuous CRM+ is a nonprofit constituent relationship management platform for fundraising, contacts, giving, campaigns, projects, events, grants, volunteering and donor engagement.
agentUseSummary: Add a dedicated Virtuous CRM API key and run 275 current official API operations through pinned routes. Safe runs 165 semantic reads directly and requires approval for 110 mutations; explicitly deprecated Reminder endpoints and documentation-only penetration-test examples are excluded.

credentialRequirements.label: Virtuous CRM API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated API key with a least-privilege permission group in Virtuous CRM+. Relay encrypts it and sends it only to api.virtuoussoftware.com as a Bearer token.

capabilities.label: Read nonprofit CRM data
capabilities.description: Use all 165 current official semantic reads.

allowed.label: Read Virtuous CRM
allowed.description: Read authorized contacts, giving, campaigns, projects, events, grants, volunteering, email, task and webhook data.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Virtuous CRM
approvalRequired.description: Create, update or delete authorized CRM records; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 165 semantic reads run directly; all 110 mutations require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 275 current operations run without Relay per-action approval; API-key permission groups, fixed routes, audits, bounds and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts 275 current official operations with fixed-origin server-side Bearer authentication.
Relay mounts 275 current official operations with fixed-origin server-side Bearer authentication.

providerSetup.blocker: Live acceptance requires an authorized Virtuous CRM+ organization, a dedicated least-privilege API key and representative nonprofit CRM records.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized administrator creates a dedicated permission group and API key, stores it through Relay Console, and validates reads, approved reversible mutations, key replacement/deletion, disconnect and post-disconnect denial in Railway staging.

evidence.supports: The official public Postman collection documents the fixed HTTPS REST origin, current resources and methods, Bearer authentication, a 1,500-request hourly limit and explicitly deprecated Reminder routes.
Virtuous recommends long-lived API keys for integrations and syncs, created with a permission group and passed as Bearer tokens.
